question: where does a placed order record a cart-level discount from a promotion
answer: The order records the reward as exactly one entry in order.discounts: amount (money), description, promotionId, promotionName, coupon. Line items carry discounts:[] and discountTotal 0.00, shipment discountAmount 0.00 - confirmed on CO260914-00002.

question: does the shopping cart record the discount percentage rate of an applied promotion
answer: No rate anywhere on the cart. But cart.discounts[0].amount keeps the RAW unrounded reward 35.4405 on a 236.27 subtotal, so the rate is exactly recoverable from the cart. KB-D4A064A5 held to the digit.

question: what fields does the cart DiscountType expose in the storefront GraphQL schema
answer: DiscountType has 7 fields including promotionId; the storefront's own cart query selects only description, amount and coupon, so promotionId is available on the cart schema but never rendered there.

question: what happens to an existing cart when a promotion is edited
answer: Promotions are re-evaluated on every storefront cart read; an edit shows up with no cart mutation. The order, by contrast, never moves.
